limitations: Only M5 hardware and6/8bit2k/8k measured here;4bit is retained in its separate current-public receipt. No32k/64k,128k or native-window performance claim.
VL requests contain text only; real-image correctness is separate evidence.
Standard omits token-id fingerprints; its token equality is unverified, and output-text digests are not substituted. Native token-equality checks passed.
Native and standard use request budget70000, but reserved native KV and lazy standard KV/sliding allocations differ.
Peak physical footprint and maximum RSS are process measurements, not inferred device/pinned allocator peaks.
Mirrored runs retain per-leg drift; no measured thermal/frequency/bandwidth attribution.
Performance receipts do not establish a model FP64 fidelity pass or remove disclosed top-token differences.
raw_retention: Immutable raw HTTP results, logs, environment and manifests retained privately; relative names and SHA256 supplied. Private paths and request IDs omitted from publication.
